verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an online government services portal that holds user records, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only notifications, communication channels, login, tax and customs service navigation, and an llms.txt 404 probe. Nothing documents exporting a user's data in open formats or leaving the service.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
